# COA A: by land, via Ashby Ford (COA development)

> UNCLASSIFIED // EXERCISE // FICTIONAL DATA

## COA statement

TF ANVIL attacks north along Route IRON. 1 MECH, the main effort, crosses Ashby Ford and seizes OBJ FALCON. 2 INF seizes OBJ KITE to fix the armour on Harrow Ridge. A SQN is the reserve at PL SLATE. TG SHOAL holds 3 AMPH at sea as a branch.

## Sketch

Main axis Route IRON to Ashby Ford to OBJ FALCON; supporting axis to OBJ KITE; reserve behind PL SLATE.

## Task organization

TF ANVIL: 1 MECH, 2 INF, A SQN, RECCE, FD REGT, CSS BN. TG SHOAL: 3 AMPH, MCM DET.

## Validity tests

Tests from FM 5-0:

- Suitable: accomplishes the mission within the intent.
- Feasible: within the forces in the scenario; ford crossing rests on A-3.
- Acceptable: risk at the ford is mitigated by the reserve.
- Distinguishable: land approach, unlike COA B.
- Complete: answers who, what, when, where, why and how.
